title: Lovely Leafy Venezuelan Prunes Wrap
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring prunes and leafy greens, this recipe is a hearty and comforting meal that is also gluten-free friendly. The combination of resinous and bouncy textures creates a unique and exciting dining experience.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the prunes and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they are heated through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour and water to create a paste.
Brush the paste onto the center of each collard green leaf.
Spoon the prune mixture onto the center of each leaf, and fold the leaves to create a wrap.
Steam the wraps over boiling water for 5-7 minutes, until the leaves are tender.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with additional prunes if desired.
